reviewer: Codex inspection of saved native PNGs, nearest-neighbor previews and actual Chromium captures
scope: New native32x64 static SD field example; expression legibility and common style. Prior projected artwork approval withdrawn.
observations: All three characters are drawn directly on32x64 cells, exactly1x2 of the32px tiles. The head occupies about half the visible height; the body and limbs are short.
Each pair of eyes remains separated with dark contours, small white highlights and distinct blue or red iris cells at native resolution.

The princess has a continuous U-shaped smile. The knight has a short calm smile with a raised corner. The demon king has angled eyebrows and an asymmetric smirk. Native and enlarged crops were inspected; expressions are not inferred from grid PASS.
The knight grips the short sword under its crossguard and the shield beside the forearm. Crowns and horns connect to the character silhouettes.
Gold, crimson, steel and violet clusters use the same upper-left light and one-native-pixel stepped contours. No anti-aliased edge is introduced by authoring or export.
The castle uses the same contours and palette as the characters. Quiet large masonry slabs and sparse grass leave the facial features legible in the map.
Contact shadows sit at the shared foot anchor. The actual browser screenshot preserves the designed facial cells and has no diagnostic highlights.
limitations: This is a deliberately simplified static SD field illustration; a walking cycle is not included.
Expression preservation is tested as pixel identity. The artistic approval is a separate visual judgment and does not certify a general automatic art-quality detector.
